searchText: Yes, we already have full specs for this and also tests. They are in the same branch you've been using for guest program. And also tests in the same eip8025 folder This is how we create the executionWitness field in the fixtures. Basically by specing out how the execution witness is created in execution-specs. https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/blob/ec23140720d6a9257a907c470ba1874623bd7b50/src/ethereum/forks/amsterdam/stateless.py#L28-L48 for the struct. but the rest of the spec code has how is generated. And the `tests/amsterdam/eip-8025` folder has many test files related to border cases of witness generation to cover many angles. to reiterate, my question is about the json output of the rpc method. so it's all rlp hex arrays like: ``` { "codes": [[]], "headers": [[]], "state": [[]] } ``` right? Correct. That's the ExecutionWitness, i shared in that link above More like: ``` { "codes": ["0x..", "0x.."], "headers": ["0x..", "0x.."], "state": ["0x..", "0x.."] } ``` right, thanks
